sections.title: باب 7 — متن (9)

paras.text: At the national level the effect of conflicts falls on weak linguistic and ethnic groups. In multi-ethnic states, since the real cause of conflict and war is ethnicities, the effect of wars too falls on them. Those which are small and weak have to bear losses. In religious conflicts the weak religious sect faces losses. They become victims of insecurity and despair, and their social and economic life is ruined. In every war the labour and business group cannot remain unaffected. Their business becomes weak and they have to face an economic crisis. Industries are ruined and a decrease occurs in investment. The nation as a whole too has to face economic problems. At the national level conflicts and wars affect the political group. During war and conflict the political popularity of those who play a constructive and positive role increases, while the graph of popularity of those who play a negative and hesitant role falls. At the national level war and conflicts also affect the cultural group. The present internal law-and-order situation of Pakistan has especially targeted cultural activities; the majority of artists have either gone abroad or have adopted silence.

paras.text: At the international level, like common people, particular groups too cannot remain unaffected by wars and conflicts. The defeated group or alliance has to face world wrath and anger. They have to bear world pressure and have to make decisions even unwillingly. The example of this is the Axis powers that lost during the First and Second World Wars, which had to face many vindictive treaties. The blow of war falls on the group of weak countries and they have to face many difficulties. They are compelled to stand in the ranks of the big powers that win the war. War and conflicts between countries also affect the groups of political leadership and political parties. Some leaders during these wars gain world honour and fame, while many people are defamed. During the First World War the American President Wilson earned a name while the German King William was defamed. During the Second World War the world political stature of the American President Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Russian President Stalin increased, while the German head Hitler was declared responsible for the world war. After the Iraq-America fight the Iraqi President Saddam Hussain was presented as a villain. In this way the groups of political parties are affected by world conflicts.

National groups:

At the national level the effect of conflicts falls on weak linguistic and ethnic groups. In multi-ethnic states, since the real cause of conflict and war is ethnicities, the effect of wars too falls on them. Those which are small and weak have to bear losses. In religious conflicts the weak religious sect faces losses. They become victims of insecurity and despair, and their social and economic life is ruined. In every war the labour and business group cannot remain unaffected. Their business becomes weak and they have to face an economic crisis. Industries are ruined and a decrease occurs in investment. The nation as a whole too has to face economic problems. At the national level conflicts and wars affect the political group. During war and conflict the political popularity of those who play a constructive and positive role increases, while the graph of popularity of those who play a negative and hesitant role falls. At the national level war and conflicts also affect the cultural group. The present internal law-and-order situation of Pakistan has especially targeted cultural activities; the majority of artists have either gone abroad or have adopted silence.

World groups:

At the international level, like common people, particular groups too cannot remain unaffected by wars and conflicts. The defeated group or alliance has to face world wrath and anger. They have to bear world pressure and have to make decisions even unwillingly. The example of this is the Axis powers that lost during the First and Second World Wars, which had to face many vindictive treaties. The blow of war falls on the group of weak countries and they have to face many difficulties. They are compelled to stand in the ranks of the big powers that win the war. War and conflicts between countries also affect the groups of political leadership and political parties. Some leaders during these wars gain world honour and fame, while many people are defamed. During the First World War the American President Wilson earned a name while the German King William was defamed. During the Second World War the world political stature of the American President Roosevelt, British Prime Minister Winston Churchill and Russian President Stalin increased, while the German head Hitler was declared responsible for the world war. After the Iraq-America fight the Iraqi President Saddam Hussain was presented as a villain. In this way the groups of political parties are affected by world conflicts.

… are. One group benefits while the other suffers loss. Because of world wars world business groups too are affected. Investment, industrialisation and trade etc. are affected. Military people too are affected by war and suffer loss of life. Groups of common people too are affected and have to face financial and human loss.

Discrimination

In human societies, from the first day, humans have faced discriminations. Human discrimination is a very great moral, religious and social evil. Its definition has been given somewhat like this:

1. According to the Encarta Dictionary, “Unjust treatment of an individual or group on the basis of race, language, age, religion or gender prejudice, malice and suspicion.”

2. According to Chambers Advanced Practical Dictionary, “The act of differentiating is discrimination.”

3. According to the Advanced Oxford Dictionary, “The act of unjust treatment of an individual or group of society compared with others is called discrimination.”

Discrimination is such a psychological and social process which exists in every society, less in some places and more in others. It can be in favour as well as against, i.e. some individual or group is getting more support and favour than others or is being kept deprived of it. In common terminology its greater inclination is towards deprivation. By discrimination a group or individual is kept deprived of opportunities and facilities. In the modern age discrimination is considered an extremely inhuman act, because it is not the characteristic of an educated society. In almost all religions of the world, especially Islam, racial discrimination has been strictly forbidden. Discrimination has many kinds or forms, i.e. economic discrimination, political discrimination, social discrimination, gender discrimination, discrimination on the basis of disability and ethnic and linguistic discrimination etc. Among these discriminations, racial discrimination has special importance.
